Collaborators.title: Collaborators
Collaborators.description: People who work on the same properties, tenants, contracts and payments as you.
Collaborators.ownerOnly: Only the owner can add or remove collaborators.
Collaborators.inviteDescription: They'll get an email to choose a password, then see the same records you do. They can't change the business's settings.
Collaborators.invitedNoEmail: {name} was added, but the invitation couldn't be emailed. Check your email settings, then resend it.
Collaborators.removeDescription: Their account is deleted and they're signed out everywhere. What they recorded stays with the business.
Collaborators.emptyDescription: Invite someone to share the work.

EmailSettings.title: Email service
EmailSettings.description: Messages your business sends, like invitations, go out from your own address through your own provider.
EmailSettings.platformDescription: Until you set up a service, messages are sent from the platform's address.
EmailSettings.fromEmailHint: An address on a domain you've verified with your provider.
EmailSettings.smtpSecureLabel: Use TLS from the start (usually port 465)
EmailSettings.keepSecret: Leave blank to keep the saved one.
EmailSettings.secretUnreadable: The saved key can no longer be read. Enter it again.
EmailSettings.removeDescription: Messages will be sent from the platform's address again, and your saved credentials are deleted.

DomainSettings.title: Web address
DomainSettings.description: Open the app at your own address, like portal.yourbusiness.ro. HTTPS is set up automatically once the address is verified.
DomainSettings.recordsTitle: Add these records at your DNS provider
DomainSettings.recordsDescription: Then check them here. DNS changes can take up to an hour to show.
DomainSettings.apexHint: For a root domain (yourbusiness.ro), add A records with the same addresses as {target} instead of the CNAME.
DomainSettings.name: Name
DomainSettings.activeDescription: Your app is live at <link>{url}</link>. Its HTTPS certificate is issued automatically on the first visit and renewed on its own.
DomainSettings.passkeyNote: Passkeys only work on the platform's own address.

errors.TXT_MISSING: The TXT record isn't there yet.
errors.NOT_POINTED: The address doesn't point at {target} yet.
errors.DNS_LOOKUP_FAILED: DNS didn't answer. Try again in a minute.
errors.DOMAIN_TAKEN: Another business already uses this address.

DomainSettings.removeDescription: The app stops answering at this address. You can add it again later.

Receipt.title: Receipt
Receipt.missingDetails: Your bank and registration details aren't filled in yet. <link>Add them in Business details</link> to show them on receipts.
Receipt.missingDetailsCollaborator: The business's bank and registration details aren't filled in yet. Ask the owner to add them.
